verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit ships an official CLI (coderabbit-probe-3, coderabbit-docs-2) that can be invoked pre-commit, and its review agent already runs automatically on PR events (implicitly CI-triggered) plus can be self-hosted (coderabbit-docs-18), suggesting scriptable/automatable use. However, no evidence explicitly documents a headless/non-interactive CI mode, exit-code/JSON output for pipeline gating, or a documented CI-integration guide (e.g., GitHub Actions step) for the CLI itself. Missing for 10: explicit CI-integration docs/examples for the CLI, headless/non-interactive flag documentation, and independent confirmation of CI usage.
